name: LIGHTROCK
source:
An mystery visual novel all about being yourself.

Because you never know what someone might do if they were you...

[Edit from [url=https://kidderkat.itch.io/lightrock]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部圍繞「做自己」展開的懸疑視覺小說。

因為你永遠猜不到，要是別人變成了你，究竟會做出些什麼……

[改編自[url=https://kidderkat.itch.io/lightrock]itch.io[/url]]
